interpretation: Counts are source files containing provider API, SDK or credential signatures. They identify potential transmission surfaces, not confirmed personal-data events or unique network calls.
critical_distinctions: cancelling a paid subscription is not deleting a provider customer record
deleting CTRL rows is not evidence that a processor deleted or expired its copy
a local model-usage log is not a provider request receipt unless it stores provider request identity and retention standing
some search calls may contain only public queries while other calls may contain private leader context; the repository does not classify this per callsite
provider deletion may be unnecessary where a binding zero-retention mode applies, but that status must be evidenced rather than assumed
email inboxes and user-controlled exports cannot be recalled by CTRL
required_registry_fields: provider request or message identity when available
contract and retention mode in force
next_gate: Classify each provider callsite by data sent and verify current official retention and deletion controls before designing provider receipts.
